title: Problem 1.12 — Categorify other knot polynomials.
exact_target: Construct invariant homology theories whose graded Euler characteristics recover other knot polynomials.

sources.citation: ULAM. AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10400012 (AMR-103-0012). CC BY 4.0.

T. Ohtsuki (editor), \emph{Problems on invariants of knots and 3-manifolds}, Geometry \& Topology Monographs 4 (2002), pp. 377--572 (published 2004), item 1.12 and its surrounding definitions and remarks.
